_comment: Krea-2 (K2) MULTI-GPU pipeline-parallel LoRA fine-tune, weights RESIDENT. See krea2/train.py. The 12.8B DiT is diced into one chunk per block and the chunks are split across GPUs; only activations cross PCIe, so no NVLink is needed. Stage weights stay on their GPU — if they do not fit, switch parallelism to 'pipeline-offload'.
_comment_topology: parallelism 'pipeline' = N GPUs, resident weights. chunks_per_stage overrides the automatic split (which balances stages by WEIGHT BYTES, not chunk count — the embed chunk carries the whole text-fusion transformer). Must sum to the number of chunks: 2 + ceil(28/blocks_per_chunk).
_comment_chunks: blocks_per_chunk only sets the dicing granularity here; nothing streams. grad_ckpt wraps each block in torch.utils.checkpoint (valid ONLY with resident stages).
_comment_batch: batch_size is PER MICROBATCH; effective batch = batch_size * n_microbatches.
_comment_ckpt: Path to the K2 DiT base weights (safetensors). See checkpoints/README.md.
_comment_mode: mode='lora': LoRA adapters on all nn.Linear + unfrozen norms/mods, whole model bf16.
